key.name: power-mode-ac
key.summary: Power mode to hold while plugged in
key.description: 0 Balanced, 1 Gaming, 2 Creator, 3 Silent, 4 Custom. -1 leaves whatever the firmware chose alone.

key.name: power-mode-battery
key.summary: Power mode to hold on battery
key.description: Same values as power-mode-ac. The EC does not change the mode by itself when the charger is unplugged, so this is a preference rather than a correction; it is what makes the machine drop to a quieter mode on battery without being asked. The mode is lost across suspend either way, which is why the daemon rewrites it on resume. The charge limit needs no equivalent because it survives on its own.

key.name: cpu-boost
key.summary: CPU power preset to hold in Custom mode
key.description: 0 Low, 1 Medium, 2 High. -1 leaves whatever the firmware has. Only acted on in Custom and only while plugged in: measured, the registers hold a value in every mode but move the graphics power limit only in Custom, and not at all on battery.

key.name: gpu-boost
key.summary: Graphics power preset to hold in Custom mode
key.description: Same values as cpu-boost. Measured to move the dGPU power limit in Custom mode on AC. The absolute wattages are not stable across machine states, so only the ordering is relied on.

key.name: lighting-effect
key.summary: Keyboard effect to restore at startup
key.description: One of off, static, spectrum, wave, reactive, breath, starlight. The firmware has no query for the running effect, so this is the only record of it -- which is also why openrazer kept its own copy. Stored as the family, with the mode beside it, rather than openrazer's flat scheme where breathSingle and breathDual were separate effects.

key.name: lighting-secondary
key.description: Only used by the two-colour modes of breath and starlight.

key.name: lighting-speed
key.description: Reactive takes 1-4 (500 ms to 2 s), starlight 1-3 (fast, normal, slow). Ignored by every other effect.

key.name: lighting-direction
key.description: 1 left, 2 right. Ignored by every other effect.

key.name: lighting-logo
key.summary: Whether the lid logo is lit

key.name: lighting-follow-screen
key.summary: Turn the keyboard and lid logo off while the display sleeps
key.description: Tracks Mutter's PowerSaveMode, which is the panel, not the session lock. Keying off the lock instead is what left the keyboard dark on a lit lock screen under openrazer -- measured, the display comes back up to twenty seconds before the lock is dismissed. The lid logo goes with the keyboard, since a lit logo over a dark keyboard reads as a bug. Off leaves both alone at all times.
